script_text: Cancer, do not mistake this week's quiet for a dead end. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury stations direct in Scorpio, your 5th House, while Venus stations direct in Libra, your 4th House, reopening a tender second chance in love. Your Moon-ruled water heart feels every emotional shift, and the Moon in Aquarius sextiles Saturn in your 11th House, grounding your emotional needs. Thursday is the turning point: the Sun in Scorpio opposes Saturn in Taurus, your 11th House, forcing a serious career or money decision. Friday, Mercury in Scorpio squares Saturn, so negotiate pay in writing. The weekend eases as the Moon enters Gemini, your 12th House, and sextiles Venus in Libra, deepening intimacy. Tuesday is your power day because Mercury direct restores your voice. Thursday is your worst day because Sun opposite Saturn challenges income. Keep your charm professional, not persuasive. Follow for daily updates.
